instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: People who strongly liked seeing others suffer were more likely to make the other person's reward smaller after watching the Stone video than after watching the Magician video. For people who felt this less strongly, there was no clear difference. You may want to say, so it really depends on personality. But there is more to the story. In the next experiment, people were again put into groups at random. But this time they could not make the reward bigger; they could only make it smaller. This time, it did not matter how strongly people liked seeing others suffer. People who watched the Stone video were more likely to make another person's reward smaller than people in the other groups. If we look only at personality, we may miss something. We need to ask not only what kind of person someone is, but also what they can do in that situation. We thought we were reading a profile of the person. Now we also notice how the stage is set.
